image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a vertical traffic light mounted against a light-colored building facade. The traffic light housing is dark gray/black with three circular signal lenses stacked vertically. The top lens appears red (though dim/unlit), the middle amber (dim/unlit), and the bottom green (unlit/dark). Each lens has a prominent protruding visor/hood. The bottom lens shows significant surface reflection or damage. A mounting bracket is visible on the left side attaching the unit to a pole or wall structure.
